seo.title: Governance & Sustainable Fisheries Program
seo.description: Community governance, BMU networks, and sustainable fisheries management.

hero.title: Governance & Sustainable Fisheries
hero.text2: Strong, collaborative governance is at the core of what Oceans Alive does  -  at least as central as coral restoration. This programme strengthens local institutions, supports communities to participate in decision-making, and promotes sustainable fisheries management through collaborative governance.

whatWeDo.heading: What We Do
whatWeDo.text2: Developed by communities and government, with OA providing technical support.
whatWeDo.text8: 17 BMUs · 265,000 ha · 7,000 fishers/households benefiting · 6-step toolkit · State of Fishery 2021 report · IUCN/EU BIOPAMA support.
whatWeDo.text13: Developed with the Kuruwitu BMU under the BMU Regulations; includes Kenya's first IUCN SAGE (Site Assessment for Governance and Equity) analysis, placing communities at the centre of marine governance.
whatWeDo.text18: Support to build the capacity of conservation CBOs and BMUs  -  patrol boats, uniforms, scout training and grants for operations.
whatWeDo.text22: Catch Assessment Surveys, Frame Surveys, the State of Fishery 2021 report and MCS plans that inform both community management and national policy, in partnership with WCS.
